notes.title: USAGIRI - New game in progress
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33021355/03ca8cee79be2dd56fbb3322fb6b218e48353095.png[/img]
Hi!
I'm very happy to announce what I'm working on next.
What do you think about cute girls with animal ears?
What's better than catgirls?
[h1]Bunny girls![/h1]
Become a patron - a person who takes care of them.
Yes, YOU! Set character name and gender if you wish.

The story will be linear this time, with one end. If you'll like it, there will be a continuation.

The game will be family-friendly, BUT... If I'll see high interest in this game, I'll finish working on Adult-Only DLC with interactive, animated scenes/minigames.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1153950/USAGIRI/

I don't know when it will be finished as I have some personal stuff to take care of (final year of studies, writing Master's thesis, etc.), but I hope for the first quarter of 2020.

If you're wondering why not something from NEKOKORO universe:
Despite the positive feedback, the production costs were too high and I still don't see any profits from it. It's too risky to make a continuation of a failed project. But If this one does well enough to cover the costs of itself AND previous games, I'll get back to it.

Best,
Mikołaj Spychał

notes.title: Choices, Choices, Choices! - Dev Log & Release date
notes.content:
Hello!
As you might notice, I've uploaded a Teaser Trailer on the Steam product page, please watch it all, it has a slow start.

In this post, I'd like to tell you more about the choices in this game and a few systems.

If you played my first game, Jake's Love Story, and liked the complexity of cause and effect, you'll love this one.
[h1]You can get around 50-70 choice points in one game![/h1]
Most choices heavily influence the story, to the point, I felt obliged to give you special options in the settings menu - I call it #Help - it will show you your progress, chances, flags, status, and few other things. In addition, I also implemented name-able game saves, to keep track where you are.
I think you'll have fun discovering all the possible outcomes.
[h1]The game will launch with 55 Steam Achievements![/h1]
They will help you check what possibilities you've seen, and which not. But they don't represent all of what I prepared for you.

And finally, but not official yet (I want to make sure there will be no delays):
[h1]The game might launch in September![/h1]
The script is almost edited, music, sounds, expressions are implemented. All what's left are testing, checking, more testing, and more checking. The game is very, very convoluted, it twists and jumps, logic is in all places. You'll see what I mean.

Best,
Mikołaj Spychał

If you'll have any questions about the game, please write in Community Hub: https://steamcommunity.com/app/1140140
